title: Biological Qubits Atlas (v3.0.0) - FP-qubits (class A'), non-optical qubits, FP biosensors
description: Biological Qubits Atlas v3.0.0 - a curated atlas of quantum-coherent and optical systems relevant to biology. This release unifies the qubits dataset into a single canonical file (82 systems across classes A, A', B, C, D) and extends the fluorescent-protein biosensor atlas to 187 entries. Version 3.0 introduces class A' (FP-qubits with direct ODMR readout): 8 rows covering EYFP 80/295 K, MagLOV, MagLOV2, mScarlet+FMN, mCherry+FMN, mScarlet-I+FMN, DmCry. Classes B, C, D are refreshed with 2024-2026 literature (SiC alkene, BNNT, SnV/GeV nanodiamonds, FND in vivo, hBN; first-in-human HP 13C,15N2-urea MRI and 129Xe FDA updates; Flavin-Guanine SCRP, 6-4 photolyase oxetane radical pair, room-temperature FMO coherence, GgCry4a). Cryptochrome Cry1 entries shown to be circadian-only are flagged as deprecated. The FP biosensor atlas adds CaBLAM, HaloDA1.0, iGluSnFR4 (f/s), ASAP4.4-Kv, PinkyCaMP, OCaMP. 63 licences and 60 PMCIDs were completed via Unpaywall and NCBI ID Converter. Validator accepts class A' and widened ranges (T: 1-400 K, year: 1980-2027). Companion documents: RELEASE_NOTES_v3.0.md, docs/FP_QUBITS_ODMR_2025.md, CITATION.cff.
notes: Release v3.0.0 (Zenodo-only distribution, no journal submission). Highlights: (1) Single canonical qubits file (data/qubits/biological_qubits_v3.csv) with 82 rows; (2) New class A' with 8 FP-qubits demonstrating direct ODMR readout; (3) FP biosensor atlas extended to 187 rows (data/optical/curated/atlas_fp_optical_v3_curated.csv); (4) Class B/C/D refresh with 2024-2026 literature; (5) Updated validator and regenerated dashboard; (6) Full provenance via DOIs, PMCIDs and licence fields.
